source_info.alignment: Offline data from different regions and years, aligned by interval; not a single site or calendar day.
source_info.scaling: Fixed dataset: seven-day historical PV and demand peaks are each scaled to 3 kW; PV is capped at 3 kW. This is scenario scaling, not a conversion of source units.
source_info.forecast_note: PV uses 17 features from the previous day; demand uses four features from the previous seven days. Neither reads target-day inputs. Intraday updates correct observed residuals without retraining.
source_info.evaluation_split: PV uses a day after the full training-script dataset; demand uses the last complete test day. Evaluation uses scaled scenario kW, not the units of the original model report.

endpoint: exact initial SOC; common reachable-energy actuator envelope
pv_self_consumption: PV delivered to load / actual PV generation; proportional battery provenance
